description: Shared Redis key contract between lodestar-app-backend and lodestar-server (auth limits and device challenges). Both services must produce and accept exactly these shapes. norm(x) = lowercase hex sha256 of x.trim().toLowerCase(). fpHash(x) = lowercase hex sha256 of the computed fingerprint id string (the same value each service already derives from the fingerPrintId cookie, or from body fingerPrintId + User-Agent).

deviceLoginLimit.writtenBy: backend checkAndBindDevices / oauth2 / social-login and server general-login, only after the identity was verified, right before returning E_LOGIN_DEVICE or redirecting to /over-login-device

deviceBind.writtenBy: backend checkAndBindDevices (before its server-to-server call to /mail-verification-code/send) and server general-login, right before E_BIND_DEVICE; NOT written while deviceBindFail >= 10
deviceBind.consumedBy: server /mail-verification-code/send (must exist) and /verify (must exist, memberId must equal body memberId; delete on success)

deviceBindFail.note: INCR on each wrong code (EXPIRE set when the counter is created); verify checks it BEFORE comparing the code; never reset by login

deviceBindSendCooldown.note: SET NX EX 60 before each send

issueCooldown.note: SET NX EX 60 before issuing a token / sending the mail

counterSemantics: Counters are incremented atomically together with setting the TTL on first creation (Lua: local n = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1]); if n == 1 then redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[1]) end; return n). A login attempt increments loginFailAccountIp, loginFailAccount and loginFailIp BEFORE the password is compared; if any returned value exceeds its cap the attempt is rejected without comparing. On a successful login loginFailAccountIp and loginFailAccount are deleted (loginFailIp is kept).
